_meta.purpose: Maintained jurisdiction-risk list for the FATF R.10 risk-based approach. Used ONLY to nudge a deterministic risk score (decision-support); it never decides. Missing/empty => no jurisdiction bump.
_meta.source_of_truth: FATF public statements — 'Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring' (grey) and 'High-Risk Jurisdictions subject to a Call for Action' (high/black). Synced to the June 2026 Paris plenary (17–19 Jun 2026) and reconciled against the firm's research note docs/research/2026-06-aml-regulatory-update.md and the watchdog state data/fatf-state.json.
_meta.naming: Names mirror the app's COUNTRIES baseline (index.html) exactly, so the lookup exact-matches the customer country/nationality fields it nudges.
_meta.maintenance: REVIEW AND UPDATE after every FATF plenary (Feb / Jun / Oct). Remove de-listed jurisdictions; add new ones. This file is a maintained control, not authoritative legal advice — verify against the latest FATF statement before relying on it.
_meta.plenary_basis: June 2026 (Paris). Added: Bosnia-Herzegovina, Iraq. Removed: Algeria, Namibia. Call-for-action list unchanged (Iran, North Korea, Myanmar).
_meta.note: Customer-base home jurisdictions (UAE, Turkey) were de-listed by FATF in 2024 and are deliberately NOT included here, to avoid false jurisdiction flags.
